The '''Wall Pumpkin''' is a decorative piece of [[furniture]] that hangs on a wall.  It can be won in the Crane Game inside the [[Movie Theater]], during {{season|fall}}.

Note that this Wall Pumpkin hangs higher on the wall than the [[Small Wall Pumpkin]].
